alerts.subject: [C10-MED] 10y Real Yield rising: 2.35% (+53bp off 90d-low)
alerts.body:
Series:   REAL10 (DFII10)
Date:     2026-07-16
Current:  2.35%
90d low:  1.82%
Move:     +53bp off 90d-low (fire ≥ +40bp)

────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
What this means:
The C10 real-yield gauge crossed its threshold: the 10-year TIPS real yield hit 2.35pp on 2026-07-16, up 0.53pp from its trailing-90-day low of 1.82pp.

内容:
C10 实际收益率信号触发阈值：截至 2026-07-16，10年期 TIPS 实际收益率升至 2.35pp，较过去90天低点 1.82pp 上升了 0.53pp。

Why it matters:
Rising real yields raise the discount rate on long-duration AI-capex cash flows and tighten financial conditions broadly — a fast 0.53pp move off the recent low is the kind of tightening shock that historically pressures the most speculative, cash-burning names first.

影响:
实际收益率上升会提高对 AI capex 这类长久期现金流的贴现率，并整体收紧金融环境——近期低点以来 0.53pp 的快速上行，正是历史上最先冲击高估值、现金流吃紧标的的那种收紧冲击。

alerts.body:
Series:   REAL10 (DFII10)
Date:     2026-07-14
Current:  2.33%
90d low:  1.78%
Move:     +55bp off 90d-low (fire ≥ +40bp)

────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
What this means:
The 10-year TIPS real yield jumped to 2.33pp on 2026-07-14, up 0.55pp from its trailing-90-day low of 1.78pp, tripping C10's real-yield-spike threshold.

内容:
10年期 TIPS 实际收益率在 2026-07-14 升至 2.33pp，较过去90天低点 1.78pp 上升了 0.55pp，触发了 C10 的实际收益率飙升阈值。

Why it matters:
Rising real yields raise the discount rate applied to long-duration growth cash flows, which is exactly the profile of AI-capex names priced on distant payback. A move this size compounds with a stronger dollar to tighten financial conditions right when hyperscalers are funding capex with debt.

影响:
实际收益率上升会提高对久期长的成长型现金流的贴现率，而这正是靠远期回报支撑估值的 AI capex 类股票的软肋。叠加走强的美元，金融条件正在收紧，偏偏此时超大规模厂商还在靠举债支撑资本开支。

OpenAI’s Growing Challenges Narrow Its IPO Window

Plus, Apple’s legal sparring, and Wall Street’s problem with AI drug discovery.

A Bloomberg headline flags that OpenAI's mounting operational challenges are narrowing its IPO window, alongside unrelated Apple legal and AI-drug-discovery items.

────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
What this means:
The 10-year real (TIPS) yield rose to 2.32% from a trailing-90-day low of 1.78%, a 0.54pp jump as of 2026-07-10.

内容:
10年期实际利率(TIPS)从过去90天低点1.78%升至2.32%，截至2026-07-10上涨0.54个百分点。

Why it matters:
Real yields are the discount rate on long-duration AI-capex bets — a sharp rise this size repriced growth/duration assets across the board and directly raises hyperscalers' cost of debt-funded capex. Crossing 2x the C10 trigger threshold escalates this from a MED to a HIGH liquidity-stress signal.

影响:
实际利率是AI资本开支这类长久期押注的贴现率——如此大幅度的快速上升会重新给成长型/长久期资产定价，并直接推高超大规模厂商靠举债支撑capex的融资成本。触及C10阈值的2倍，信号级别从MED升至HIGH。
